capacity_note: Strong adapters did not outperform small CoC; strong observable CoC stayed near identity but strong ray CoC learned. Do not infer a universal capacity effect.
interpretation: Same96-parameter adapter with CoC makes correct geometry useful under this budget; change includes scale and K placement, not only a physical formula.
DINO exceeds VGGT on both legacy-test sources; dev PSNR and boundary evidence differ. No robust VGGT-specific geometry advantage established.
DINO and VGGT differ in pretraining, feature layers and temporal aggregation; these results do not show geometry is useless.
Two-plane collage references can favor semantic/appearance separation; does not prove behavior on real volumetric scenes.
